name: 美图看看 (Meitu Kankan)
summary: A small, fast free picture viewer from Meitu that was very popular on Chinese Windows PCs in the early 2010s, with folder favourites, a view of all pictures in subfolders and one-click sharing to Chinese social networks. It is no longer developed (last release 2.7.8) but still offered for download.
where_it_wins: Tiny and light on old PCs
Shows all pictures of all subfolders at once (穿透文件夹)
CMYK PSD shown as in Photoshop
where_schnellbild_wins: Maintained, runs natively on Apple silicon Macs
No bundled 360 Safe Guard or partner installers
HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP and videos
